trophies.difficulty: Very long — the platinum is the sum of the other 54 trophies, about 200 hours. Source: PowerPyx.
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. There is no shortcut: the road runs through the whole story, the 100% completion checklist, every collectible set and the long money and stunt grinds. Follow the roadmap stages in order and treat the platinum as the last trophy you earn, never the first one you chase.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally in the opening mission.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Nothing here can be missed: just finish the mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is the one spot reported as possibly missable. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. From this chapter on, Jason and Lucia are both playable, so most of the side list opens up — use the downtime between story missions to start the collectibles and activities rather than leaving them all for after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay. Sources: PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. This is also the chapter where the bank vaults open up through an optional mission — start the Maximum Withdrawal vault robberies here rather than after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing the story.
trophies.guide: Play the final mission through to the credits. Keep a manual save just before it, as published guides advise for any ending mission, and finish any chapter-gated side content first — after the story the world opens fully, but anything tied to a chapter you have already left cannot be replayed. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock in order, so just keep playing the story and this one arrives on its own. If a mission fails, retry it from the checkpoint — the trophy only needs a completion, not a perfect run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-story heist, so it comes to you in the mission order — there is nothing extra to find or prepare beyond playing the story through.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every story mission trophy, it unlocks the moment the mission ends, so keep following the story and it will come to you.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It arrives in the story's mission order — play the story through and the trophy pops when the mission's final objective is done.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is a main-story mission, so follow the story order and it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Keep playing the story in order; the trophy unlocks the moment the operation is over.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.difficulty: Hardest trophy — the 100% checklist is the longest single task, roughly 60% of true completion. Source: PowerPyx.
trophies.guide: Finish the in-game 100% completion checklist, found under Progress, then Stats, after the story — earlier progress counts toward it, so nothing you do early is wasted. The checklist is narrower than doing literally everything: published guides put it at roughly 60% of true completion. Work through the other trophies first and the checklist will be most of the way there; the remaining items are the collectibles, the stunt and challenge counts, and the stranger strands. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.difficulty: Long grind — 250 of 397 stunts count, so you can skip the hardest ones. Source: PowerPyx.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. Published guides count 397 stunts in the world, so you can skip the ones that give you trouble — only 300 are needed for 100% completion. Stunts you do naturally while travelling count too, so start early and let the total build up. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.difficulty: Easy — 9 activity types, each tried once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: any single attempt counts, you do not need to win or finish first. Work through the activity list in the world — races, shooting ranges, fishing, bowling, arcade games and the rest — and tick each type off as you sample it. The in-game activity menu shows which types you have tried. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.difficulty: Hard — 42 gold medals across 12 ranges; the most skill-heavy trophy after the 100%.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Each challenge has its own gold score threshold, so learn one weapon and one range at a time rather than rushing through. Published guides agree this is the most demanding skill trophy on the list after the 100% completion gold. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.difficulty: Medium — a win at each of the 14 drone race locations.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own course, so learn the turns of one course before moving on, and use the race restart freely — only wins count, not attempts. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.difficulty: Medium — 20 different races won.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: the same race won twice counts once, so you need 20 distinct events. Races are spread across cars, bikes and boats, and any win counts — pick the vehicle class you are strongest in first, then work through the rest. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.difficulty: Easy to medium — one fishing challenge win against Cal.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take the challenge: it is a contest of catches, not of gear, so follow the on-screen prompts and keep your line steady. You can retry the challenge if you lose it. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.difficulty: Easy — finish any one arcade game.
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through to its end — any game counts, so choose the shortest one you enjoy. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing Andy's strand.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore and meet their characters, so if Andy's missions are not showing yet, keep playing the story and checking the map. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing Kenton's strand.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands appear as you explore Leonida, so keep checking the map between story missions if Kenton has not shown up yet. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing Billy's strand.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Like the other stranger strands, it unlocks as you explore — meet Billy, follow his missions in order, and the trophy pops at the end of the last one. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.difficulty: Medium — 8 full stranger strands, doable after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one character — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest — and only full strands count. Published guides note that not every side questline counts, so work through the named stranger strands and check your count as you go. All of it can be done after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing Randy's strand.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida — meet Randy, follow his missions in order, and the trophy pops at the end. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.difficulty: Easy — unlocks naturally by finishing Tyrone's strand.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission and complete it. Follow his missions in order as they appear on the map; the trophy unlocks when the final one ends. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.difficulty: Medium — 18 spots; the only trophy reported as possibly missable.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy published guides flag as possibly missable: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward it and disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Do the spots as you meet them, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and do not leave them all for after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.difficulty: Easy to medium — one unique-animal hunt for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Find Bret, take his hunt, and track the animal he names — it is a single named animal, not a general hunting quota, so follow the hunt's own trail rather than hunting at random. The hunt can be done after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.difficulty: Medium — 3 full card sets collected.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, and a set only counts when every card in it is found — pick one set, sweep its region thoroughly, and move on. Published guides treat the cards as a pure collectible hunt with no deadline. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.difficulty: Long grind — WAiNK at 100 different locations.
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each location counts once, so keep moving — photographing the same spot twice adds nothing. Work region by region and the count climbs steadily as you explore. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.difficulty: Long grind — 50 challenges completed.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small objectives scattered through activities and the world — races, stunts, shooting and more — and any 50 count. They build up naturally while you chase the other trophies, so check your count during clean-up and finish the easiest ones left. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.difficulty: Medium — needs a 4-star wanted level, a partner, and a clean escape.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Do it somewhere with open roads and cover nearby, and break line of sight before the search closes in — the trophy needs the full escape, not just dropping to a lower level. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.difficulty: Medium — three shop robberies in a row, partner present, heat kept.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them — the chain breaks if the heat drops. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them quickly one after another, and keep moving: the trophy is about the chain, not the takings. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.difficulty: Medium — 100 distinct vehicles discovered.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Each new model you find counts once, so variety is everything — drive, ride and steal widely instead of sticking to one favourite. Vehicles you meet in missions and traffic all count toward the total. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.difficulty: Tricky — five takedowns inside one Combat Focus use.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies group together — a mission firefight or a wanted-level standoff — trigger Combat Focus, and chain the five takedowns before it ends. If the focus runs out early, retry: the count resets each use. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.difficulty: Tricky — the exact step is not pinned down by any published guide yet.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. The official description is the only hint published so far, and no guide has pinned down the exact step yet — our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game: try leaving the airport by an aircraft outside a scheduled flight, after the story when the airport is fully open. If a step fails, try another way out of VCIA and keep the attempt cheap. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; official description, our own advice.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Official description — our own advice, not yet checked in the game

trophies.difficulty: Tricky — the exact step is not pinned down by any published guide yet.
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke with no instructions in it, and no published guide has pinned down the exact step yet — our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game: the name points at the Rhino tank, so look for a tank-related feat in free roam after the story, and try driving or fighting in one until the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; official description, our own advice.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Official description — our own advice, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.difficulty: Tricky — a clean robbery, no detection at all.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, move slowly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm — one spotted moment fails it, so plan the exit before you take anything and retry if you are seen. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.difficulty: Medium — 5 of 8 vaults, each escape at 4 stars.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape from each one. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready and a route out planned before you go in. You only need 5 of the 8, so skip the vaults that give you the most trouble. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.difficulty: Easy to medium — one armored truck robbery and a clean escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on a quiet stretch of road, take its cargo, and break away before the police box you in — plan the escape route before you strike, since the trophy needs the escape, not just the robbery. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.difficulty: Long grind — all 52 regions found.
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 regions of Leonida. The count is by region, not by map percentage, so sweep the map systematically — coast, countryside, islands and city — and check the region count as you go so no corner is left undiscovered. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.difficulty: Medium — one illegal operation robbed for each of the 9 gangs.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang's operation is a separate target, so work through the gangs one by one — a second robbery of the same gang adds nothing. The operations are found by exploring gang territory after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.difficulty: Easy — one cocktail at the right spot on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view over the water and order a cocktail — the trophy is about the place, not the drink, so any cocktail at the right spot counts. No published guide has pinned down the exact venue yet; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game: try the beachfront bars first. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; official description, our own advice.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Official description — our own advice, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.difficulty: Easy to medium — drive out of a showroom through the glass.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's frontage and out onto the street — the trophy wants the smash, not a quiet exit, so pick a showroom with a big glass front and go straight through it. No published guide has pinned down the exact showroom yet; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; official description, our own advice.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Official description — our own advice, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.difficulty: Easy — a follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to that alley, bowl, and follow through on the shot — the trophy is tied to that specific alley, not to bowling in general. No published guide has pinned down the exact shot yet; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game: play a full game there and finish your throws cleanly. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; official description, our own advice.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Official description — our own advice, not yet checked in the game

trophies.difficulty: Tricky — the exact step is not pinned down by any published guide yet.
trophies.guide: The official description is a riddle, and no published guide has pinned down the exact step yet — our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game: the name and description point at a partnership that the public notices, so look for a co-op or duo activity that draws a crowd, and try it with your partner after the story. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; official description, our own advice.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Official description — our own advice, not yet checked in the game

trophies.difficulty: Very long grind — 500 choices made.
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices. Choices are the small decisions scattered through the world — dialogue picks, activity choices, purchases and the like — and they add up across the whole playthrough. This is a background grind: play normally, choose actively instead of skipping, and the count will climb toward 500 by the end of clean-up. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.difficulty: Tricky — the exact step is not pinned down by any published guide yet.
trophies.guide: The official description hints at succeeding on a second attempt, and no published guide has pinned down the exact step yet — our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game: retry something you failed once and complete it on the second try, ideally a mission or activity with a clear fail state. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; official description, our own advice.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Official description — our own advice, not yet checked in the game

trophies.difficulty: Tricky — the exact step is not pinned down by any published guide yet.
trophies.guide: The official description reads like a reaction to something unexpected, and no published guide has pinned down the exact step yet — our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game: look for a strange or scripted surprise event in the world and trigger it; if nothing happens, keep exploring odd corners of Leonida after the story. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; official description, our own advice.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Official description — our own advice, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.difficulty: Tricky — knock enemies over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock them down. Pick a slow vehicle, a crowded street and a clear run at your target — speed helps the knockdown, but too much speed makes the swing miss. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.difficulty: Long grind — $250,000 laundered through contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your contacts to clean them, a little at a time, and the total adds up across the playthrough. Start laundering early so the grind finishes with the rest of clean-up. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.difficulty: Long grind — $100,000 spent in shops.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — clothes, weapons, food, vehicles — so buy what you need as you go instead of hoarding cash, and the total will be most of the way there by clean-up time. The last stretch can be finished on big-ticket items. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.difficulty: Medium — all 8 garage properties bought.
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought with in-game money, so this one is gated by cash more than by exploration — save up, buy them one by one as they appear on the map, and keep the most expensive for last. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.difficulty: Easy to medium — 10 vehicles registered in the app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — any ten count, so use the cars and bikes you meet in everyday driving rather than hunting rare ones. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: On the Spot
